build_get_datasets: build a python module to create train and validation SequenceDatasets from a D4RL environment name and seed
run_main: run the main function to iterate over hopper walker2d and halfcheetah D4RL environments and compute trajectory statistics
create_sequence_dataset: create a SequenceDataset with a specified sequence length discount factor and reward flag from a D4RL dataset split
test_get_datasets: test the get_datasets function by loading a hopper-medium-v2 environment and verifying train and validation datasets are returned
review_trajectory_statistics: review the trajectory_statistics method called on train datasets across multiple D4RL environments and discount values
